Tinybird RawTree rawtree.com

RawTree is the cloud database for raw analytical data.

A schema-free OLAP database that adapts to your workloads.
Send raw events or telemetry as JSON, query with SQL.

  • 01 Schema-free, without losing performance. Real-time analytics over structured or semi-structured data. Ingest first and query immediately.
  • 02 Adapts to
    your workloads.     Keys and projections adapt to real query patterns, so there is far less manual tuning.
  • 03 ClickHouse® power
    and features.     Fully ClickHouse compatible,
    with all its features still available
    under the hood.
RawTree
Performance RawTree vs ClickHouse · querying data on S3

Fast on raw data, even straight from S3.

Five queries over the same data on S3,
with cold (empty caches) and hot runs.

  • 16.0x faster Cold queries, median.
  • 7.8x faster Hot queries.
  • 10.9x less Data decompressed.
  • 7.0x fewer S3 GET requests.

# Install the CLI
$ curl -fsSL https://rawtree.com/install.sh | bash

# Sign in
$ rtree login

# Insert data: just JSON, no schema
$ rtree insert --table events \
    --data '{"action":"click","user":"alice","value":42}'

# Query your data
$ rtree query "SELECT action, count()
    FROM events GROUP BY action"
# Insert data
$ curl -X POST https://api.rawtree.com/v1/tables/events \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $RAWTREE_API_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"action":"click","user":"alice","value":42}'

# Query your data
$ curl -X POST https://api.rawtree.com/v1/query \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $RAWTREE_API_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
      "sql": "SELECT action, count() FROM events GROUP BY action"
    }'
# Install the RawTree skill
$ npx skills add rawtreedb/agent-skills

# Claude Code
$ claude mcp add --transport http rawtree \
    https://mcp.rawtree.com/mcp

# Codex
$ codex mcp add rawtree --url https://mcp.rawtree.com/mcp

# OpenCode
$ opencode mcp add rawtree --url https://mcp.rawtree.com/mcp
import { RawTree } from "@rawtree/sdk";

const rawtree = new RawTree({
  apiKey: process.env.RAWTREE_API_KEY!,
});

await rawtree.insert({
  table: "events",
  values: [{ action: "click", user: "alice", value: 42 }],
});

await rawtree.query({
  sql: "SELECT action, count() FROM events GROUP BY action",
});

The RawTree
challenge

Real-time recommendation
for shoppers who won’t wait

14–15 November | UPC Barcelona

The story datathon.rawtree.dev

Sell more than the best sellers.

An online store shows a row of ten recommended products on every page. Today it just shows the best sellers of the category of the last product viewed. Build something that sells more, tested live on shoppers arriving in real time.

  • 3sto answer
    each shopper.
  • 10products,
    ranked.
  • ~5Kproducts in
    10 categories.
  • 3/sshoppers,
    day and night.
  • 2hfinal round
    that counts.
RawTree
What you build datathon.rawtree.dev

A system that runs
on its own, all weekend.

No files to upload and nobody pressing buttons:
your system is your submission.

  • 01 Read requests. Each one describes a shopper
    and what they just did in this session: device, region, page and the products they viewed.
  • 02 Answer in 3 seconds. Write back an ordered list
    of 10 product IDs. Late or invalid
    answers are replaced by the best sellers.
  • 03 Learn as you go. Private feedback on every answer
    (clicks, purchases, revenue) and a shared stream of everything
    happening in the store.
RawTree
How it works datathon.rawtree.dev

One loop,
three times a second.

  • 01 A shopper arrives. A new record lands in shop.requests, about 3 per second.
  • 02 Your system reads it. Poll the table, compute features, rank the catalogue.
  • 03 You answer. Insert 10 product IDs into team_NN.submissions
    within 3s.
  • 04 The shopper reacts. A hidden model simulates the decision
    to click and buy, and writes team_NN.feedback.
  • Read your feedback and the live shop.events, improve, redeploy.
    Every team gets the same shoppers at the same time.
RawTree
The data Every column is Dynamic · cast join keys: product_id::String

Everything lives in RawTree.

One API key per team: read the shared shop database,
read and write your own team_NN. JSON in, SQL out, no schema.

  • shop.catalog

    ~5,000 products: category, subcategory, brand, price, a short description, active flag.

    5K recordsshared
  • shop.history_sessions

    60 days of carousel impressions from the old system: shown, clicked, bought, plus propensities.

    2M recordsshared
  • shop.history_events

    60 days of organic activity outside the carousel: views, add-to-cart, purchases.

    12M recordsshared
  • shop.requests

    One record per shopper arriving at the carousel. This is what you answer.

    3 / slive
  • shop.events · catalog_updates

    Store activity in real time (spot the trends) and catalogue changes: new products, prices, stock-outs.

    ~50 / slive
  • team_NN.feedback · scratch

    What happened with each of your answers, only visible to you. Plus a free table for your own features.

    privateyour team

  1. 01Exactly 10 distinct, active product IDs.Products go out of stock during
    the event.
  2. 02Within 3 seconds of the request ts.Measured by the organisers.
    The baseline answers in about 1s.
  3. 03One answer per request.Batch your inserts, for example
    every half second.
  4. 04Order matters.Shoppers look at the first slots
    much more than at the last ones.

The store moves datathon.rawtree.dev

Teams that generalise beat teams that memorise.

The final round brings new shoppers,
new products and new trends.

  1. 01New shoppers.Many arrive with no history at all.
  2. 02New products.Only a description, no interactions yet.
  3. 03Trends.Visible early in the live events.
  4. 04Price changes.Announced in the catalogue updates.
  5. 05Stock-outs.Inactive products are invalid answers.
RawTree
Timeline Barcelona time (CET, UTC+1)

Practise on Saturday, count on Sunday.

A full day of practice on the live stream,
two hours that decide it all.

  1. Saturday · now Kick-off. Data, keys and starter kit released. Get your key at the RawTree stand.
  2. Sat 10:00 – Sun 10:00 Practice round. Live stream and a public leaderboard, updated every 10 minutes.
  3. Sun 10:00 – 12:00 Final round. New shoppers, new products, new trends. The leaderboard goes dark: only a status light per team.
  4. Sunday 12:00 Results. The stream stops and the final ranking appears on its own. Then, presentations.

Have your best version running by Sunday 10:00. Shoppers keep arriving while you sleep: unanswered requests get the fallback.

Scoring Conversion and cold start

Beat the baseline. Chase the oracle.

0 012345678900123456789001234567890

BaselineBest sellers of the category of the last product viewed: the starter kit.

OracleThe best list possible, picked by the hidden model itself. Out of reach.

  • The formula 100 × (team − base) ÷ (oracle − base)
  • No luck Purchase probability, not the coin flip; bought items lose appeal.
  • Tie-breaker Expected revenue per request.

Best agentic use
of RawTree.

An AI agent that relies on RawTree to store, analyse
and act on data. The agent is the protagonist, not a wrapper.

  • 01 Open to all teams. Whatever main challenge
